title: Assessment answer
description: What an agent answers an audit's assessment request with: the request's id and basis, an assessment of each member and of the set, a recent decision, and any findings. Fields this tool does not read are refused, to catch a misspelt field. The rules across fields, such as which members exist, stay in Models::AssessmentAnswer.

base_commit.description: A full commit sha, as start-audit gave it, or null outside git. This tool refuses anything else before running git.

last_completed_revision.description: The revision of the principle's last completed audit record when start-audit printed the request, or null when there was none. The request id binds it.

items.description: A fresh assessment, with assessment, delivery and evidence, or the marker carried_forward: true for a member the request carries forward. Models::MemberAssessments refuses an entry that is neither.

judge_because.description: Why the request judges this member afresh, as its template prints it; sent back or not, Models::MemberAssessments keeps nothing from it.

delivery.description: observed or not_observed; Models::AssessmentAnswer refuses any other with invalid_delivery.

observed_at.description: On an observed delivery only, when the agent saw what observation describes, if that was before this audit; omitted or null, it is this audit's time, so the agent never types a clock time. Models::MemberSighting refuses it on not_observed, one not a time to the second as audited_at is, such as 2026-11-01T09:30:00Z, whose UTC offset, such as +05:30, it reads as the same instant in UTC, and one after the answer, and refuses an observation repeated word for word from the last full audit as observation_repeats_last_audit unless it is that audit's date or null.

check_result.description: A member check's result as the agent reports it: the command, exactly as the map names it, its exit_status or, when it could not be run, not_run_reason, and review_basis, one line saying what the review before the run rested on, which an exit_status for a check the stored record did not run needs. Models::AssessmentAnswer refuses any other combination with invalid_check_result.

exit_status.description: The run's exit status. A string is the template's placeholder, left unfilled, which Models::ReportedCheck reads as not given.

not_run_reason.description: Why the check could not be run. Null, as a template to edit prints it, is none.

review_basis.description: What the review before the run rested on. Null drops an unchanged check's kept line.

left_as_printed_rule.description: The note start-audit --as template prints at its head saying how a field left as printed is read, which an answer may send back and Models::AssessmentAnswer ignores, whatever it holds.

carried_checks_to_run.description: The carried members whose check start-audit --as template still asks to run, which an answer may send back and Models::AssessmentAnswer ignores.

shared_check_instructions.description: How to run and report the checks of each standing once, with the members it is for, which start-audit --as template prints at its head, and an answer may send back and Models::AssessmentAnswer ignores.

check_instructions.description: Each checked member's own lines beside shared_check_instructions, by member id, which start-audit --as template prints at its head, and an answer may send back and Models::AssessmentAnswer ignores.

evidence.description: Pointers to where the decision is recorded. A string is the template's placeholder, left as printed, which Models::RecentDecision reads as not given.

loading_decisions.description: One decision for each member the request lists in loads_to_check_against_activation. Which decision each needs, and its reason, is checked by Models::LoadsToCheck.

prior_finding_decisions.description: One decision for each finding the request lists in prior_findings. Which decision each needs, and its reason, is checked by Models::PriorFindings.

finding_problem.description: The finding's problem as the template prints it beside its decision, for the agent deciding it to read. Sent back, it is read as nothing; problem restates the finding.

first_raised_at.description: On a still_holds decision, an earlier time the finding was first raised: the audited_at of the record that raised_in holds, which Models::FirstRaisedClaim checks.

raised_in.pattern: ^([0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?|With first_raised_at: its record's commit, full sha; else leave)$
raised_in.x-unmatched-advice: is not this template's placeholder nor a full commit sha, as an answer filled from another template leaves it: start from this request's response_template
raised_in.description: The full sha of the commit whose audit record, at .principles/audits/ID.json or the earlier .memeplex/audits/ID.json, left this finding open at first_raised_at. The one other value is the template's placeholder, word for word, which Models::PriorFindingDecision reads as not given, so only a sha reaches git.

waits_on.description: On a still_holds decision that leaves the finding deferred, a new one line saying whom it waits on and to decide what; null drops the one it carried. Leaving it out keeps it.

x-type-refusal-advice.says: with path, plus starting_at (or heading) when the file holds more than this finding, or with url alone, a whole https link, for a write-up outside the project such as an issue

recorded_at.description: On a still_holds decision, a new pointer to the write-up, or null for none. A string is the template's placeholder, left as printed.

evidence.description: On a resolved decision, pointers to where the fix shows. A string is the template's placeholder, left as printed, which Models::PriorFindingDecision reads as not given.

problem_evidence.description: On a still_holds decision, pointers to where the problem is: for a finding marked evidence_not_kept, its evidence, which the record keeps; for one whose record keeps evidence, each the new place of the kept item named by replaces, its position in the finding's evidence, which must no longer be found. Models::StillHoldsRestatement refuses any other. A string is the template's placeholder, left as printed.

replaces.description: The position of the kept item it replaces. A string is the template's placeholder, which Models::EvidenceReplacements refuses as naming no item.

x-unread-field-advice.recorded_at: give it in this finding's disposition, in the correction answer this assessment leads to
